content.text: Section 11 meets or exceeds the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 is a dedicated transition and data-return clause that meets the preferred position: six months of transition assistance on expiry or termination for any reason at the rates in the expiring Order Form (rate-capped, better for us than "then-current rates"); return of all Customer Data within thirty days of request in a complete, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and no withholding for fee disputes; and secure deletion with written officer certification after we confirm successful return, subject only to a legally required copy that stays protected and use-restricted. Section 10.1 preserves our Customer Data rights and does not condition assistance on payment, and Sections 13 and 15 contain no early-deletion or data-hostage right. Nothing to redline.
